Virtual Control Plane resources

Fields every OpenEngine resource shares. Resources follow Kubernetes conventions: apiVersion and kind say what a document is, metadata identifies it, spec holds what its author wants, and status, where a kind has one, is what the service observed. Applying a resource creates it under a new name and updates it under a known one; status and the service-set metadata fields are ignored on apply. Several resources may share one file, separated by ---.

Validate files with uv run python packages/contracts/tooling/resources.py check FILE… from v2/.

Workspace

apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1 · kind: Workspace · defined in virtual_control_plane/v1/resources/workspace.schema.yaml

A stable place where agents work, provisioned on a provider. The Graph Engine applies one when a step needs it, under a name it chooses, so that tool grants can name the workspace before it runs anything. Applying under a new name creates the workspace, allocates its ws_… ID and provisions its first runtime; applying an unchanged workspace changes nothing. The name is a DNS label because grants refer to workspaces by it.

Example from review-job-88.workspace.yaml
apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1
kind: Workspace
metadata:
  name: review-job-88
spec:
  provider: smolvm
  resources:
    cpuMillis: 2000
    memoryMib: 4096
    diskGib: 20
  tools: [git, terminal]
  context:
    repositories:
      - url: https://github.com/acme/api
        ref: main
    instructions: Follow the repository's CONTRIBUTING.md.
  requiredCapabilities: [checkpoint, isolation_microvm]
  owner:
    jobId: job_88
    executionId: exec_88a
    stepAttemptId: stepa_88_impl_1

ObjectMeta

Identifies a resource that is not namespaced (Graph, Loop, Connection). The service sets everything else about it, such as its revision and timestamps.

FieldTypeDescription
namerequiredstringLower-case name, unique among resources of its kind: a letter, then letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64 characters.
Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.
labelsmap[string]stringShort values for selecting and grouping resources, such as team: platform. Values are at most 63 characters of letters, digits, -, _ and ., starting and ending alphanumeric, or empty.
Keys: Pattern ^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?[A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?$. Keys: At most 317 characters. Values: Pattern ^([A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)?$. At most 64 entries.
annotationsmap[string]stringFree-form notes for tools and people. Services never act on them.
Keys: Pattern ^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?[A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?$. Keys: At most 317 characters. Values: At most 4096 characters. At most 64 entries.

WorkspaceSpec

What the workspace runs on and is provisioned with. provider, resources and requiredCapabilities cannot change once it exists (INVALID_ARGUMENT; destroy it and apply again). Changes to tools and context take effect on its next runtime.

FieldTypeDescription
providerrequiredstringThe provider that supplies its compute, such as process, smolvm or kubernetes.
Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.
resourcesResourcesRequested compute. Omitted fields take the provider's defaults.
tools[]stringTools made available to agents in the workspace, such as git or terminal.
Items: Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$. Default []. Unique.
contextContextWhat the workspace is provisioned with.
requiredCapabilities[]stringProvider capabilities the workspace needs. A provider lacking one is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY.
Items: One of checkpoint, suspend, restore_same_host, restore_any_host, isolation_container, isolation_microvm, isolation_vm. Default []. Unique.
ownerOwnerThe Graph Engine records the workspace serves. VCP stores and filters on them but does not interpret them.
